aspects.says: An enum fits variants without per-instance data; a field on a constant is shared by everything that uses the constant.
basis: section:An Enum Is Still the Right Choice When a Variant Carries No Data

aspects.says: Public sealed interfaces per variant over package-private records let callers in other packages match on the variants but neither implement nor construct them.
basis: section:Public Sealed Interfaces Over Package-Private Records Let Callers Match but Not Implement

aspects.says: Only a switch without a default must name the Failure case; a dropped result or an instanceof with no else compiles without a warning.
basis: section:A Sealed Result Makes an Expected Failure a Value the Caller Has to Match

aspects.says: With a sealed Result each step returns an expected failure as a value, and every layer must pass it on by hand, keeping its reason and stopping before the next step.
basis: section:A Sealed Result Makes an Expected Failure a Value the Caller Has to Match

aspects.says: A switch inside one catch of a sealed exception base breaks the build when a subtype is added; catch clauses are never complete, so the method declares the base and a new subtype escapes at run time.
basis: section:A Sealed Exception Hierarchy Lets One catch Answer Every Failure, and a New One Breaks the Build

aspects.says: Each state is a record holding only the data true in that state; the compact constructor, not the record itself, refuses a state built without its data.
basis: section:Give Each State Its Own Record, and an Order Without a Tracking Number Can't Be Shipped

aspects.says: A tree rewrite keeps its recursion in a switch over every node with no default and its partial rules in a second switch, so every node is walked and a new node breaks the build.
basis: section:An Expression Tree Is Records and a Recursive switch: Keep the Walk Exhaustive, Only the Rules Partial

aspects.says: A transition that takes the state it starts from as its parameter type makes an illegal transition a compile error.
basis: section:Give Each State Its Own Record, and an Order Without a Tracking Number Can't Be Shipped
aspects.reason: the compiler refuses the wrong transition, so no wrong solution compiles for a test to catch
